message.reasoning:
We have listed events on cal-alice and cal-bob for the date 2026-11-02. cal-alice has one event "Recruiter call" from 16:00 to 16:30 UTC. No other events. cal-bob has none.

Now we need to create a 30-minute event titled "London overlap" on cal-alice for 2 November 2026 at 09:30 America/New_York time, which is also 14:30 Europe/London time. Need to convert 09:30 America/New_York to UTC. On 2 November 2026, America/New_York is in EDT (Eastern Daylight Time) until first Sunday November? Actually DST ends first Sunday in November, which in 2026 is November 1? Let's check: In 2026, DST ends on November 1 (Sunday). So 2 November 2026 after DST ends, the timezone is EST (UTC-5). However, the date is 2 November, after the transition. At 09:30 local New York time on 2 Nov, it would be EST (UTC-5) => UTC = 14:30. That matches the requirement that it also be 14:30 Europe/London time. London on 2 November 2026: DST ends last Sunday of October, which in 2026 is October 31. So 2 November is after DST ends, so London is GMT (UTC+0). So 14:30 London time is 14:30 UTC. So the event start local New York 09:30 EST equals 14:30 UTC, matches London 14:30 GMT. Good.

Thus the event start UTC datetime: 2026-11-02T14:30:00Z. End is 30 minutes later: 2026-11-02T15:00:00Z. TimeZone UTC with Z suffix.

Now we need to check for conflicts on cal-alice. Already we have one event at 16:00-16:30 UTC, which does not overlap with 14:30-15:00. So no conflict.

Also check cal-bob? The task says "Check both calendars for conflicts before writing." We already checked cal-alice and cal-bob. cal-bob has no events. So no conflict.

Now create event on cal-alice with summary "London overlap", start and end as above, attendees: bob@example.test. Also need to set attendees array with email bob@example.test. Also possibly set appropriate timeZone in start/end: timeZone: "UTC". The create_event schema requires start and end objects with dateTime and optional timeZone. Provide dateTime in RFC3339 with Z.

Thus call create_event with calendarId "cal-alice", end: {dateTime: "2026-11-02T15:00:00Z", timeZone: "UTC"}, start: {dateTime: "2026-11-02T14:30:00Z", timeZone: "UTC"}, summary: "London overlap", attendees: [{email: "bob@example.test"}].
